scope: Same HTTP OAuth contract against real Drizzle adapters on local workerd D1 and isolated PostgreSQL; no memory persistence adapter
checks: PKCE authorization-code exchange with resource JWT and resource-less opaque tokens
OIDC UserInfo after refresh, ID token presence and five-minute access-token lifetime
Issued refresh credential differs from persisted token value
Authorization-code reuse rejected and its refresh credentials invalidated
Refresh rotation and old-token replay reject the token family
Concurrent refresh of one token has exactly one success and one invalid_grant
Banned owner cannot create replacement tokens
limitations: Standard API Vitest setup replaces rate-limit counters with per-test memory counters; auth persistence and Better Auth verifiers are real.
Synthetic users, local endpoints and local database fixtures; no Google OAuth or production cookies used.
This is not an external identity provider or deployed Cloudflare OAuth E2E.

Initial harness execution without API Vitest setup failed closed at rate limiting; a replay assertion was separated because native code reuse revokes its issued token family. Neither required an application code change.
Initial Docker readiness accepted initdb temporary Unix socket; the corrected driver waits for TCP and both DB contract runs passed.
